title: Judges Bible Quiz - Chapter 6
description: Ten questions on Judges 6: Gideon's call, with Midian's oppression, the angel at Ophrah, the altar of Baal torn down and the sign of the fleece.

questions.text: Into whose hand did Yahweh deliver Israel for seven years?
questions.explanation: Judges 6:1 says Israel did evil in Yahweh's sight, so Yahweh delivered them into the hand of Midian seven years.

questions.text: To what does the text compare the Midianites who came into the land with their livestock and tents?
questions.explanation: They came in as locusts for multitude, and they and their camels were without number.

questions.text: Where was Gideon beating out wheat when Yahweh's angel came?
questions.explanation: Gideon was beating out wheat in the wine press, to hide it from the Midianites.

answers.text: In a cave in the mountains
On the roof of his house

questions.text: How did Yahweh's angel greet Gideon?
questions.explanation: The angel appeared to him and said, "Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!"

answers.text: "Blessed are you above all the tribes!"
"Fear not, servant of the Most High!"
"Yahweh is with you, you mighty man of valor!"

questions.text: Gideon said his family was the poorest in which tribe?
questions.explanation: Gideon said, "My family is the poorest in Manasseh, and I am the least in my father's house."

questions.text: What happened when the angel touched the meat and the unleavened cakes with his staff?
questions.explanation: Fire went up out of the rock and consumed the meat and the unleavened cakes, and the angel departed out of his sight.

answers.text: Fire went up out of the rock and consumed them
They were carried up to heaven by a strong wind from the east
Water flowed out over the rock
The angel sat down and ate them

questions.text: What name did Gideon give the altar he built in Ophrah?
questions.explanation: Gideon built an altar there to Yahweh and called it "Yahweh is Peace."

questions.text: Why did Gideon throw down the altar of Baal at night instead of by day?
questions.explanation: Because he feared his father's household and the men of the city, he could not do it by day, so he did it by night.

answers.text: The angel had told him to wait until it was completely dark
The altar was guarded by Midianites during the day
He feared his father's household and the men of the city
He was working in the fields all day

questions.text: What name did Joash give his son Gideon after the altar of Baal was broken down?
questions.explanation: Joash named him Jerub-Baal, saying, "Let Baal contend against him, because he has broken down his altar."

questions.text: In Gideon's second test with the fleece, what did he ask God to do?
questions.explanation: Gideon asked that it be dry only on the fleece and that there be dew on all the ground, and God did so that night.

answers.text: Make dew fall on the fleece only, with all the ground left dry
Send fire to burn up the fleece
Make the fleece dry and the ground wet with dew
Send rain on the threshing floor
